Free crypto widgets for your site

Three live, embeddable widgets — a liquidation calculator, the Fear & Greed index and a real-time liquidation feed. One line of HTML each, free forever.

Liquidation calculator widget

Drop a live crypto liquidation calculator onto your website, blog or trading community in one line of HTML. It pulls live prices, handles longs & shorts and any coin — free, no signup, no API key.

Copy the embed code

<iframe src="https://marginpad.io/widget/liquidation-calculator/?coin=BTC" width="360" height="440" loading="lazy" style="border:0;border-radius:14px;max-width:100%" title="Liquidation Calculator by MarginPad"></iframe>

Pick a coin

Change ?coin=BTC to any ticker — the widget loads that coin's live price automatically:

BTC ETH SOL XRP BNB DOGE

Why embed it?

A live calculator keeps readers on your page longer and gives real utility to any article about leverage, liquidation or risk. It is fully self-contained — just an <iframe> — so it can't slow down or break your site. Attribution isn't required, but the small "Powered by MarginPad" link is appreciated and helps keep the tools free.
